description: AILKIN 45W USB-C Fast Charging Adapter delivers powerful and efficient charging for a wide range of devices. With 45W Power Delivery, it quickly charges Google Pixel 10/10 Pro/10 Pro XL/10 Pro Fold, Pixel 9 Series, Pixel 8/7/6/5 Series, Chromebooks, Pixel Buds, and other USB-C devices. Its compact and lightweight design makes it ideal for home, office, or travel use. Built-in safety protections safeguard against over-current, over-voltage, overheating, and short circuits, ensuring reliable and secure charging every time.
